new_result.name: LOW_ENDPOINT_EXACT_BACKTRACK_GLOBAL_OUTSIDE_BYPASS
new_result.statement: In a low-endpoint exact-backtrack heavy bridge p<.r with q incomparable to p,r and p prec_* q prec_* r, after strict span descent is exhausted for both adjacent active pairs, every noncentral Hasse leak witness lies strictly outside the full strong-order bridge interval [p,r]_*. The account02/B10 r12 noncentral >2E/33 channel for the current pair (q,r) can therefore be selected instead of the central backtrack channel: U(q,r) gives a same-right-ray Psi_R increase; D(q,r)\{p} gives a strict opposite-ray envelope expansion. Thus a choice-based recursion never needs to take a literal low-endpoint exact-backtrack edge.

first_unpaid: POS3-OUTSIDE-ENVELOPE-REUSE-v1: exclude first reuse in a recursion whose fixed-ray stretches have the account01/B10 strict potential and whose surviving ray switches are strict envelope expansions through witnesses outside the preceding heavy bridge. High-endpoint [3/11,1/3) remains separate.
